_doc: Overrides of the toy runner's default expectation (Pass/ -> pass, Fail/ -> fail). Keys: check number -> 'Pass|Fail/<file name>' -> {expected?, reason, failing_sheets?}. 'expected' overrides the decision; only rulings by Patrick belong there. 'failing_sheets' is the exact set of sheets the check must flag (the sheets named by its mistake locations), derived from a ruling and the toy's Overview row; it lets a gate whose toys all fail tell a correct check from one that fails everything.
